game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing winter bandits.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Maze 3 (19×13, 39 junctions): collect 3 crystal(s) from the branches and reach beacon (15, 7). Use a C main program to Program synthesis. Print [16]; final file-scope values must be {}.
controls: Write int main(void) with declarations, assignments, printf and braces. Movement calls moveRight(n), moveLeft(n), moveUp(n), moveDown(n) are game helpers from logicade.h. Run or Step verifies real map goals, printed values and global state in the documented safe C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Snowdrift Barracks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Creating Simple C Programs and Program Structure

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the beacon fire by solving code steps involving tests_passed that move the firewood keeper forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the beacon fire first, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Function Test Arena – Snowdrift Barracks Race
hint: Use printf with stdio.h. File-scope declarations belong before main; block locals hide names only within that block. Coordinates start at the top left.
